info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Features: Hot Desking Sign-in via Voice Portal API
Features: Hot Desking Sign-in via Voice Portal
Voice Portal Hot desking sign in details for a location

params.name: locationId
params.description: Location in which the hot desking sign in resides.

params.name: orgId
params.description: ID of the organization. Only admin users of another organization (such as partners) may use this parameter as the default is the same organization as the token used to access the API.

items.docs:
Get the Hot desking sign in details for a location.

This requires a full or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.
